text: What is the essential difference between distance vector and link state?
choices: Distance vector routers know only distances and directions from neighbours; link state routers each hold a complete map of the area and compute shortest paths themselves
explanation: A distance vector router navigates by signposts and cannot verify a neighbour's claim, which produces count-to-infinity. A link state router has a map, so it can see that a path loops — and the information needed to detect the loop is exactly what distance vector throws away.
